description: The Agence Nationale de la Statistique et de la Démographie (ANSD) of Senegal published the final results of the fifth General Population and Housing Census (RGPH-5, 2023) as a national report split into chapters and as fourteen regional reports. Chapter 8 on housing gives the percentage of households in each region, split into urban and rural areas, by dwelling type, wall, roof and floor materials, main lighting source, main cooking fuel, source and mode of drinking water supply, toilet type and sharing, and disposal of wastewater, sludge and refuse. Nationally 74.4 percent of households lit their homes with electricity from the national utility (94.1 percent urban, 40.5 percent rural), 8.5 percent used solar, and 75.0 percent drew water from a domestic tap. Format and access: free PDF reports; the census microdata are catalogued on the ANADS portal and released on request under the statistics law. Licence: reports free to download; microdata under ANSD access conditions. Caveats: tables are percentages of households inside PDFs, so values must be transcribed; the locality directory holds counts of population and households, not services. Simulation uses: regional electrification, water and sanitation access for network planning and exposure studies. Related records: the Côte d'Ivoire RGPH 2021 and Burkina Faso RGPH 2019 census tables.
